content.intro: A definition such as `function obj:run(x)` is shorthand that receives `self` as the first parameter. Calling with `obj:run(3)` passes `obj` automatically; a dot call does not.

content_blocks.title: Core explanation
content_blocks.text: A definition such as `function obj:run(x)` is shorthand that receives `self` as the first parameter. Calling with `obj:run(3)` passes `obj` automatically; a dot call does not.
